responsibility: Implements the collect2 linker wrapper that sits after compilation to drive the real linker while discovering static constructor, destructor, exception-frame, and target-specific export information from objects and libraries. It owns argument processing, temporary-file generation, object/archive scanning via nm or direct COFF/XCOFF readers, constructor/destructor list construction, AIX export-list handling, LTO- and dsymutil-related postprocessing, and the logic that synthesizes helper objects or linker inputs needed to make initialization and finalization run correctly on targets that require collection.
same_name_distinction: This is the main implementation file in the collect2 pair: it drives the linker-wrapper workflow and consumes helpers such as collect2-aix and collect-utils to scan objects, gather constructor/destructor and export data, and run post-link actions. Unlike gcc/collect2.h, it is not a small shared-state/interface declaration header; it contains the executable collect2 logic itself.
